papers.title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
papers.summary: AI agents evaluated on physics research tasks show strong local scientific results but frequently fail to fully resolve research questions due to incomplete evidence and unresolved applicability limits.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 36 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: RAP: A Dataset for Paper-to-Poster Generation via Declarative Markup from Human-Crafted Exemplars
papers.summary: RAP introduces a large-scale dataset and benchmark for generating conference posters from papers as a visual coding task, providing verified paper-poster-markup triplets and both retrieval-based and trained generation methods.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 23 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
papers.summary: HexaShell is a coding agent that controls a dual-arm robot via vision and self-written tools, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo but struggling with contact-heavy tasks.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 161 upvotes no Hugging Face.

papers.title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
papers.summary: MIST separates scene setup from change execution to isolate memory failures in video world models, and M3-Agent improves instruction execution to significantly boost benchmark scores.
papers.insight: Em alta na comunidade, com 21 upvotes no Hugging Face.
